ruleSet.predicate: CRS, axis order, units, extent, orientation, source geometry and map-frame binding match the frozen case manifest; topology and feature identity are preserved.
ruleSet.coordinateTolerance: Use the input dataset's declared XYTolerance; missing CRS/XYTolerance or undeclared transformation yields UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never PASS.
ruleSet.rasterGrid: CRS, dimensions, cell size, origin, extent and band alignment must match the frozen common-grid manifest exactly.

ruleSet.predicate: Integer counts, categories, class breaks, source facts and canonical decimal answers equal the frozen known-answer values.
ruleSet.decimalComparison: Canonical decimal at the stored reference precision; do not round after observing a result.

ruleSet.predicate: No class, category, NoData region, uncertainty, method or source fact is removed or visually altered to improve appearance; all quantitative color tokens stay bound to data and legend.
Required map frame and applicable legend, scale bar, north arrow, units and source stay within the page, have no essential-element overlap, and bind to the same map-frame revision.
Title, labels, categories, units and sources match the frozen semantic strings; no missing glyph, clipping, truncation or unrecorded font substitution.
ruleSet.fontFloorOrigin: D-085 calibration choice, frozen here as a candidate because FINAL §4-5 requires a pre-result minimum-font threshold but supplies no numeric value.

ruleSet.predicate: Every required artifact opens/decodes, matches its manifest hash/size/type and keeps input-to-output provenance; overwrite is refused.

The 6x3 input matrix is fully attempted; valid normal/boundary cases produce the defined deliverable, invalid cases are correctly refused before writes; edit, undo, data update and interruption recovery are evidenced.

Require at least three spectrally independent bands, a shared grid, an explicit NoData rule, band identity/spectral-role evidence, and source/provenance hash before TS08 normal/boundary input is eligible.
ruleSet.spectralIndependenceEvidence: Each band has an identified spectral role and distinct original source-band lineage; multiple copies of the same single-band source do not qualify.

visualReview.sourceStatus: FINAL initial suggestion; fixed here as M1 candidate

knownAnswerPolicy.missingGoldBehavior: NOT-AVAILABLE-PENDING-USER; never fabricate a gold result

scoringExclusions.allowedOnlyWhen: Applicability and exclusion reason are registered before the run.
scoringExclusions.timeoutsCancellationsAndRefusals: retain in the applicable attempt distribution; a correct invalid-input refusal is not a map success

hiddenSetPolicy.hiddenAccess: separate restricted custodian; no hidden example details in tool context

candidateCalibrationNotes: Numeric exactness, 8 pt font floor, zero semantic-color token delta and zero overlay shift are D-085 calibration choices. FINAL requires thresholds to be fixed before results but does not publish these numeric values.
The initial preview/repair budgets and reviewer thresholds are sourced from FINAL. This definition does not claim any runtime measurement, visual review or benchmark pass.
A4/A3 at 300 DPI is the FINAL initial print test profile. Large-canvas/PSB capability remains a separate unverified profile.
